title: Bounds for the initial compiled configuration
statement: Let $W,B,P$ be natural numbers, and form the initial compiled configuration from a bit string $x$, label $l$, zero-valued registers, Boolean memory contents $M$, memory-head position $p$, and output word $out$. If $|p|\le P$, then this configuration has each register head in $[-1,W]$, each decider-work-tape head of absolute position at most $B$, and memory-head position of absolute value at most $P$.
hypotheses_covered: Bit string $x$, label $l$, Boolean memory contents $M$, and output word $out$
